hero.tagline: Frontend-focused software developer building modern, scalable web interfaces — with complementary backend experience.

about.heading: About
about.lead: I'm a software developer with over 2 years of professional experience, primarily focused on frontend development, with complementary backend and full-stack experience.
about.body: I've worked on the development, maintenance, and evolution of web applications across enterprise projects and client-specific solutions. My experience centers on building modern, responsive, and scalable user interfaces using component-based architectures, REST API integration, and solid software engineering practices.

highlights: Develop reusable and encapsulated web components following a component-based architecture, prioritizing modularity, scalability, and application maintainability.
Work with Lit to build efficient web interfaces and components, leveraging its reactive rendering system and lightweight architecture to create reusable solutions.
Design and execute unit tests using Mocha, Sinon, and Open Web Components (open-wc), validating component logic, event behavior, and dependencies through mocks, stubs, and assertions.
Develop end-to-end tests using Cucumber, validating key functional flows and ensuring applications meet defined user scenarios and business rules.
Maintain code quality standards and development best practices by using ESLint, test coverage, and low-complexity criteria to build clean, consistent, and maintainable code.
Analyze functional requirements and translate them into technical solutions, considering both client needs and domain logic to implement features aligned with project objectives.

Designed, developed, and maintained reusable and encapsulated web components, adhering to component-based architecture principles to ensure modularity, reusability, and maintainability across applications.

Built and maintained web components using Lit, leveraging its reactive rendering system, templating capabilities, and lightweight architecture to deliver efficient and reusable user interface components.

Developed comprehensive unit test suites using Mocha, Sinon, and Open Web Components (open-wc), covering component behavior, business logic, event handling, and dependencies through mocks, stubs, and assertions.
Implemented end-to-end tests with Cucumber to validate complete application workflows, ensuring functionality accurately reflected real-world user scenarios and business processes.

Followed strict code quality practices, including ESLint, linting rules, unit test coverage, low-complexity code, maintainable architecture, and consistent coding standards, with a focus on writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code.

Translated functional requirements into technical implementations by developing solutions aligned with client business requirements and domain logic, ensuring components and workflows matched the intended business processes.
Provided support and maintenance for software systems across frontend and backend environments, ensuring application stability, performance, and continuous improvement.

Managed and optimized databases, focusing on indexing, query performance, data organization, and overall database efficiency. Analyzed and improved database structures to ensure reliable performance as system and data volumes increased.
Supported and enhanced an Angular 14 application by implementing new features, maintaining existing functionality, resolving issues, and improving usability and performance.
Supported and maintained backend functionality using .NET and ASP.NET Core, including APIs, business logic, data access, and integrations between frontend applications and backend services.
Provided technical support to clients by identifying, analyzing, and resolving platform-related issues. Communicated with users to understand requirements and provide appropriate technical solutions.
Adopted a pixel-perfect development approach.
Implemented pixel-perfect user interfaces based on Figma designs, delivering responsive and visually consistent experiences across different browsers and devices.
Participated in the development and maintenance of multiple software projects.
Developed web applications using Angular 18 and 19, integrating services through GraphQL, implementing responsive interfaces, and applying styles with Sass and RxJS.
Developed interactive and dynamic user interfaces with React 18, using Framer Motion for animations, Tailwind CSS for styling, and analytics tools to monitor user behavior.
Contributed to backend development with Go by creating a WhatsApp chatbot prototype that automated user interactions and message processing.
Developed, customized, and maintained WordPress websites, implementing features and components tailored to project requirements.

mock.note: Selected projects built with modern frontend and full-stack technologies.

project-one.title: E-commerce Platform
project-one.summary: A scalable e-commerce platform with a Next.js frontend and Strapi headless CMS.
project-one.description: A modern e-commerce application built with Next.js, TypeScript, and modular SASS. Strapi powers product, user, and order management, while the frontend integrates the CMS API and uses server-side rendering to support a responsive, SEO-conscious shopping experience.

project-two.title: Todo App
project-two.summary: A task management app with filtering, checklists, due dates, themes, and offline persistence.
project-two.description: A React, TypeScript, and SASS task manager that lets users create, search, classify, and filter tasks by status. Tasks support descriptions, checklists, due dates, and command-based actions, with IndexedDB persistence for retaining data across reloads and offline use.

project-three.title: StoreFrontEnd
project-three.summary: An e-commerce frontend with product browsing, cart management, PayPal payments, and administration.
project-three.description: A React, TypeScript, SASS, and Redux storefront connected to a FastAPI backend. Users can browse products by category, manage their cart, pay through PayPal, and add reviews, while an administration panel supports product and category management.
